title: Binding-Specific Relearning Savings for Test-Time Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.22381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When a fact becomes harder to elicit from a language model, has the model lost it, or has it merely become less accessible? Parameter-updating test-time continual learning agents are usually evaluated by current output accuracy; we ask whether that measurement captures how prior experience shapes later updates. We test whether learning a specific factual binding produces a later relearning advantage beyond familiarity with its entity, answer vocabulary, format, or query slot. In Qwen2.5-1.5B, we compare three matched, counterbalanced histories: LEARNED receives the correct binding, CONTROL receives matched exposure without it, and WRONG receives a competing relation-valid answer in the same slot. After an identical rehearsal-free continual fine-tuning stream, LEARNED reacquires the target faster than CONTROL at a prespecified checkpoint of partial forgetting. translated_abstract: 当一个事实从语言模型中变得更难被提取时，模型是真的丢失了这个事实，还是它仅仅变得不那么容易被访问到？参数更新的测试时持续学习智能体通常以当前输出准确率来评估；我们探究这种测量方式是否能捕捉到先前经验如何塑造后续的更新。我们检验学习一个特定的“事实绑定”是否会在之后产生再学习优势，且这种优势超越了对相关实体、答案词汇、格式或查询槽位的熟悉性。在Qwen2.5-1.5B模型上，我们比较了三种匹配且经过平衡处理的历史条件：LEARNED（学习组）接受正确的绑定，CONTROL（对照组）接受匹配的暴露但不包含该绑定，WRONG（错误组）在同一查询槽位接受一个竞争性的、关系上有效的答案。在完全相同的无回放持续微调数据流之后，在预设的部分遗忘检查点上，LEARNED组比CONTROL组更快地重新习得目标事实。WRONG组相比CONTROL组没有表现出正向优势，而它与LEA（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现在测试时持续学习中，模型习得的特定事实绑定（而非对实体、答案词汇、格式或查询槽位的熟悉性）能在部分遗忘后带来再学习加速，且错误绑定不产生此优势，表明现有仅依赖输出准确率的评估方式无法捕捉先前经验对后续更新的塑造作用。
en_tdlr: The paper demonstrates that learning a specific factual binding in language models yields a binding-specific relearning advantage after partial forgetting—beyond mere familiarity with entities, answer vocabulary, format, or query slots—suggesting that standard output-accuracy evaluations of test-time continual learning fail to capture how prior experience shapes later updates.
